correctionRecord.what: The named narrow first check was executed (first-check/FC1 + FC1.1, preregistered before each execution) and found to be KL-000's I2 restated -- verdict (a) of the registered decision rule. The superseded nextGate text below is preserved verbatim. The kernel does NOT advance: a check discharged by a prerequisite advances nothing.
correctionRecord.evidence: first-check/FINDING-FC1.md with results/fc1-result.json and results/fc11-result.json: the incomplete-coverage repository world cannot obtain a clean conclusion (not_established, coverage reason); its re-labelled twin sits inside KL-000's 176,120-world enumeration and produces an identical receipt in every name-free field, diverging on exactly the echoed identifier strings and the digest. 'Mandatory file' maps to 'declared location' by renaming; no new evidence about the evaluator was produced. Also demonstrated on purpose: the under-declaration twin (W3) obtains a clean conclusion by omitting files from the declaration -- ADV-001 in repository costume, locating KL-001's real risk in the not-yet-existing mapping layer.
correctionRecord.registrationDefect: FC1's expectation E4 failed as registered (it quantified over name-carrying receipt fields); preserved as-is and corrected by the FC1.1 registration. The drafting error is RUN-20260807-6's own, recorded in FINDING-FC1.md.

nextGate: The REAL first gate, now that the named narrow check is discharged: (1) the mapping pipeline that turns a repository into ledgers -- what counts as a mandatory file, what counts as searched, which scanner outputs become which roots -- with its mapping rules registered (this is where ADV-001 and root-attribution honesty live; FC1's W3 demonstrates the exposure); (2) the frozen corpus: seeded generation of repositories with machine-checkable planted defects and clean controls, digest-manifested BEFORE any evaluation; (3) registered endpoints: the false-clean rate, and baseline true-positive recall measured BEFORE the dual ledger is applied (without which the 95%-preservation target is unfalsifiable); (4) the v0.2 preregistration carrying all of it. Estimated cost: roughly one focused run (generator 300-500 lines, pipeline 200-400 lines, registration + fixtures + tests); zero spend unless a metered model sits in the pipeline, which requires founder authorization first. NOT COMMITTED -- committing it is the owner's act.
